design: LatestMarketSnapshotStore keeps (inode, consumed byte offset, line count, last 4096 bytes before offset); _sync_locked preads only [offset,size), consumes only newline-terminated rows, and rebuilds from zero on inode change, shrink, changed tail bytes (in-place compaction followed by growth), or same-size/new-mtime rewrite. Own appends/compactions advance the position without re-parsing. Appended lines are folded through the unchanged _market_snapshots_from_lines (byte-identical to the deployed reader; tombstones applied in order by _fold_new_lines); any parse error triggers a from-zero read so the error text equals a fresh read. Journal format and compaction output unchanged.
smoke_command: python3 scripts/ci_source_ingestion_test_shards.py --shards 4 --max-test-seconds 300 -> exit 0; ran 2100 (skipped 22) of 2100 collected (re-run after final code)
